text: Macron S.p.A. is an Italian sportswear company (Bologna, founded 1971); in March 2019 ION Group, a London-based financial-software company founded by Andrea Pignataro, acquired a majority stake (58.5%) in Macron from the Consilium fund.

source.name: Wikipedia (it): Macron (azienda)
source.quote: acquisisce la quota di maggioranza (il 58,5%) dal fondo Consilium. L'operazione è effettuata attraverso la Koima Limited, società con sede a Dublino

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia (en): ION Group
additionalSources.quote: ION Group, also known as ION and ION Investment Group, is a financial data and software company headquartered in London.
